title: Superintegrable systems of two interacting spin-$\frac12$ particles with first-order vector integrals of motion
summary: We study quantum superintegrability for two interacting non-relativistic spin-$\frac12$ particles in three-dimensional Euclidean space. The Hamiltonian contains a central potential together with spin-orbit, spin-spin, tensor, and quadratic spin-orbit interaction terms, all depending only on the relative distance. We restrict the classification to the $V_4=0$ case, so that the spin-momentum interaction term is not included.
